faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.invite.question: How do I invite Niko to my server?
faq.invite.answer: Use the Add to Discord button in the site header to start the invite flow. You’ll need permission to add apps to the server.
faq.setup.question: Where can I find setup instructions and command help?
faq.setup.answer: The documentation library includes setup guides, feature walkthroughs, and a searchable command reference.
faq.broken.question: Why isn’t a command or feature working?

faq.bug.question: How do I report a bug or request a feature?
faq.bug.after: and post in the appropriate help or feedback channel. Include steps to reproduce bugs, and never share passwords or private tokens.
